relevantExcerpts: The Click&Clean web browser extension is a Private Data Cleaner for Google Chrome web browser.
You can choose one of the predefined cleaning modes: Low - Medium - High and Dev mode.
You can remove your browsing data from the beginning of time or from a certain period of time: from the past 1-24 hours, from the past week or choose any date and time you wish.
Delete Browsing History ... Empty the Cache - Delete Cookies - Clear Saved Passwords - Clear Saved Form Data - Delete Local Storage ...
option to save your browsing data to an HTML file before deleting that data.
Version: Click&Clean for Google Chrome 9.8.1.0; Released: May 29, 2024; License: Freeware; OS: Windows 11 / 10 / 8.1 / Mac OS X / Linux / Chrome OS; Browser version: Google Chrome 115+.
Related Apps: Click&Clean for Microsoft Edge; Click&Clean for Firefox.
